name: EPIC 220465040

text.card: A red giant 4,431 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 2.01 solar masses and 9.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,157 K at its surface.
